title: Sage's Serendipity

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Catchin' a train or just here to chat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Catchin' a train or just here to chat?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Well, thankfully no one calls it the Hub, but other than that it's chill. A permanent place fostering transience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, thankfully no one calls it the Hub, but other than that it's chill. A permanent place fostering transience.

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Yup, yup! Whatchya got hot pockets? Figure you're here for a reason or am I losing my touch?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yup, yup! Whatchya got hot pockets? Figure you're here for a reason or am I losing my touch?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Oh Neon Gods and Plasteel Rails... What are you on right now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh Neon Gods and Plasteel Rails... What are you on right now?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: So just the usual nonsense, got it. Well, to play along: whatchya got hot pockets? Figure you're here for a reason or am I losing my touch?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So just the usual nonsense, got it. Well, to play along: whatchya got hot pockets? Figure you're here for a reason or am I losing my touch?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: P-a-r-t-y time. Like it. Just don't fall on a set of tracks when the rail comes through. Watched that happen once. You ever see someone's brain toothpaste outta their own ears?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: P-a-r-t-y time. Like it. Just don't fall on a set of tracks when the rail comes through. Watched that happen once. You ever see someone's brain toothpaste outta their own ears?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Cloud nine spectator high. Some trick-hack from Eastern Res decided to try and cross one of the twins. Got to watch them chase his sorry ass through the station and out the other side. Fool could rrruuunnn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cloud nine spectator high. Some trick-hack from Eastern Res decided to try and cross one of the twins. Got to watch them chase his sorry ass through the station and out the other side. Fool could rrruuunnn.

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Eh. What's the worse? This is all a dream? Ha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh. What's the worse? This is all a dream? Ha.

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: The MedEd drug? Yeah. Who hasn't? Why you wanna be someone else for a night? Or you looking to learn something specific?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The MedEd drug? Yeah. Who hasn't? Why you wanna be someone else for a night? Or you looking to learn something specific?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Ohhhhh, you already have some. Cool, cool. You sure you don't want it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ohhhhh, you already have some. Cool, cool. You sure you don't want it?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Mind if I grab it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mind if I grab it?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Respect. Tonight's going to be wicked and I owe yah one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Respect. Tonight's going to be wicked and I owe yah one.

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: I mean ultimately it's up to you. Whatever you fall asleep thinking about. The last thing on your mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean ultimately it's up to you. Whatever you fall asleep thinking about. The last thing on your mind.

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Like a specific person? Ehhh, they kinda frown on that. You can pay primo for a chem-tech to cook you up an off-street patch. Then of course you run the risk of the nano-fibers rotting into the first few layers of your skin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like a specific person? Ehhh, they kinda frown on that. You can pay primo for a chem-tech to cook you up an off-street patch. Then of course you run the risk of the nano-fibers rotting into the first few layers of your skin.

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Well then use what yah got! It's fun to wake up with the memory of a fun life and a few kernels of wisdom tucked in every once and awhile. Like a hangover you finally want to have linger on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well then use what yah got! It's fun to wake up with the memory of a fun life and a few kernels of wisdom tucked in every once and awhile. Like a hangover you finally want to have linger on.

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Legit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Legit?

nodes.speaker: Sage Hullen
nodes.text: Rad. You're in for a fun night.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rad. You're in for a fun night.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's the Hub?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's the Hub?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Chitter chatter - what's the matter?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Chitter chatter - what's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Interesting way to look at it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting way to look at it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Interesting way to look at it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Interesting way to look at it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Business as usual.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Business as usual.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All the things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All the things.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you on right now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you on right now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you on right now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you on right now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well you sure seem to be having fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well you sure seem to be having fun.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well you sure seem to be having fun.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well you sure seem to be having fun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever used "LevelUp!" ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever used "LevelUp!" ?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Both?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Both?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are the options?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are the options?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Think I'll pass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think I'll pass.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not my kind of thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not my kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Here you go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here you go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if I want something specific?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if I want something specific?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What if I want something specific?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What if I want something specific?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep the arm, thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep the arm, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, let's go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, let's go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want it? I'm all set.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want it? I'm all set.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want it? I'm all set.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want it? I'm all set.
